body.p: The attached sheets include replacement sheets for FIG. 1 through FIG. 9.
Replacement sheet for FIG. 1 deletes the duplicate reference character "110" shown on the "field" as identified in the Exparte Quayle Action.

Replacement sheet for FIG. 9 has amended step "908" of flowchart "900" to recite "UPON RECEIVING THE START FIRST ACCESS POINT ACKNOWLEDGMENT MESSAGE, MOMENTARILY ACTIVATING THE HAPTIC FEEDBACK DEVICE" as recommended in the Exparte Quayle Action for consistency purposes.
No amendments have been made to FIG. 2 through FIG. 8. Attachment: Replacement Sheets
This is in response to the Exparte Quayle Action mailed November 20, 2024. In the Office Action:
" The drawings are objected to as failing to comply with 37 CFR 1.84(p)(4); and
" Claims 7 and 15 are objected to because of typographical informalities.
By this amendment, Claim 7, Claim 15, FIG. 1, and FIG. 9 have been amended to address and incorporate the corrections identified in the Ex parte Quayle Action.

In view of the foregoing, Applicant respectfully submits that the application is in condition for allowance. Applicant respectfully requests the Examiner to contact the undersigned agent if there are any outstanding issues.
